description: She wears a floor-length rust-red gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold-beige floral woven trim outlines the neckline, shoulders, sleeves, central front and hem. A narrow linked metal plaque belt has hanging chains at the hips. A cream underdress appears through the lower front opening. A warm tan-brown wrap with matching embroidered edges rests around both arms and hangs at the sides. Small drop earrings and a delicate round pendant necklace complement the dress; dark brown closed shoes are visible.
